safeguards.name: fresh held-out corpus
safeguards.rationale: V8 materializes 20 new task IDs with manifest-linked public and hidden tree digests.

safeguards.name: condition isolation
safeguards.rationale: The wrapper disables automatic Skill search for both conditions and the audit rejects global baseline reads or missing treatment snapshot reads.

safeguards.name: blind post-exit scoring
safeguards.rationale: The versioned scorer copies hidden tests into a temporary candidate directory only after the Agent process exits.

safeguards.name: complete-pair gate
safeguards.rationale: The delegated runner checkpoints every pair and marks incomplete conditions interrupted; the V8 audit can only add an ineligibility reason.

safeguards.name: immutable preregistration
safeguards.rationale: Model, Harness, prompts, corpus, scripts, task plan, seed, and analysis thresholds are hash-linked before collection.

design_boundary.rationale: The generator owns fixture construction, the runner owns paired execution, the wrapper owns Skill-search isolation, the audit owns collection eligibility, and the scorer owns hidden contracts.

dependency_audit.rationale: No dependency or lockfile change; only existing Python standard-library and Codex CLI surfaces are used.

extension_decision.rationale: No application extension point or public adapter contract is added.

data_ownership.rationale: Public workspaces, hidden reference trees, prompt inputs, raw outputs, and result records have separate lifecycle boundaries; hidden content remains scorer-only.

error_model.rationale: Timeout, nonzero Agent exit, scope violation, public failure, hidden failure, missing artifact, and isolation contamination remain distinct recorded outcomes.

contract_evolution.rationale: V8 is a new versioned envelope and corpus; V7's interrupted result remains historical and is not rebound to the corrected runner.

operational_budget.rationale: Agent and hidden-test timeouts remain explicit in the runner; collection uses fixed complete pairs with no early stopping.

threat_boundary.rationale: Hidden tests, reference repairs, condition labels, and prior outputs stay outside the repair Agent input boundary; native Codex isolation is protocol isolation, not a security sandbox.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The V8 protocol, corpus, tests, README, and evidence ledger form one atomic verified Git scope before collection.

release_recovery.rationale: This is an offline evaluation protocol with no production rollout.

data_migration.rationale: No application schema or user data is changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: Only non-secret model and Harness identifiers are frozen; no credentials or Skill contents are duplicated into logs or metadata.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No runtime or build dependency is added or updated.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README records V8's isolation limitation and the not-run boundary; the test suite records the exact audit and scorer contracts.

reproducibility.rationale: The manifest, prompts, scripts, Skill revision, task strata, randomization seed, timeouts, and analyzer thresholds are hash-linked in the planned preregistration.

remaining_risks: No V8 Agent condition has run; no Skill repair-success or causal-quality improvement claim is supported.
Native Codex process and workspace isolation is protocol isolation, not a filesystem or container security boundary.
The synthetic corpus covers selected boundary, ownership, retry, and integration contracts and cannot represent every production causal failure.

The full package suite requires the repository's normal Python environment with pytest available for the external replay; a PYTHONNOUSERSITE run intentionally reports that prerequisite as unavailable.
